title: Source-Finder Bycatch Cleanup: rejected UX candidates stop becoming open resources

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.94 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.94 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow source-finder filtering release; targeted source regressions plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on the fresh deployed v0.15.93 ZIP/log audit and local targeted proof. A fresh deployed v0.15.94 ZIP/log audit is still required before claiming provider package quality improvement.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.93 UX ZIP/log audit that regraded 97/A with six citation review-row caveats.
Source-finder attachment applies the UX weak-source gate before adding resources, so first-result bycatch does not inflate open-resource counts.
Weak source-finder candidates are discarded instead of exported as sourceReviewRows, while real missing-proof review rows remain visible.
Hyphenated user-experience text and A/B testing references now satisfy the UX source relevance gate when concept-linked.
The release explicitly requires a fresh deployed v0.15.94 ZIP/log audit before claiming clean provider output.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.94 UX ZIP/log audit and verify no source-finder bycatch ships as sourceReviewRows or open-resource proof, and that valid A/B testing evidence remains trusted when concept-linked.
